name: Whisper-asr-CPU
description: CPU-ONLY Whisper ASR Webservice (no NVIDIA GPU required). Same faster-whisper HTTP API with word-level timestamps, but transcription runs on the CPU + system RAM. It WORKS but is MUCH slower than GPU - expect roughly 5-15x longer (a 50-min episode can take well over an hour). This uses the SAME image as the GPU template on purpose, so WhisperX and the SubSyncarr multilingual patch are guaranteed compatible; it simply never requests a GPU and sets ASR_DEVICE=cpu. (The image carries CUDA libraries it won't use - it still runs fine on a GPU-less box. Advanced users can swap the Repository tag to onerahmet/openai-whisper-asr-webservice:latest for a smaller CPU image, but then verify the patch files still match.) NOTE: WhisperX word-alignment on CPU is extremely slow, so SubSyncarr skips or down-scopes alignment on CPU-only setups. Leave the two "SubSyncarr patch" mappings empty if you do not use SubSyncarr.

paths.name: Models
paths.description: Host folder that persists downloaded models. Keeps the model OUT of the docker image.

paths.name: SubSyncarr patch: webservice.py
paths.description: SubSyncarr multilingual patch - bind-mounts the patched file over the image's copy. Survives image upgrades. Leave EMPTY if you do not use SubSyncarr.

paths.name: SubSyncarr patch: faster_whisper_engine.py
paths.description: SubSyncarr multilingual patch - bind-mounts the patched file over the image's copy. Survives image upgrades. Leave EMPTY if you do not use SubSyncarr.

ports.name: WebUI / API Port
ports.description: HTTP API + Swagger docs (http://host:9000/docs). Change the host port if a GPU Whisper container already uses 9000.

variables.name: ASR_ENGINE
variables.description: Use faster_whisper (supports SubSyncarr's multilingual=true). Do NOT set to whisperx.

variables.name: ASR_MODEL
variables.description: Model: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. On a weak CPU, 'medium' or 'small' trade accuracy for a big speed-up.

variables.name: ASR_QUANTIZATION
variables.description: int8 = smallest + fastest on CPU. (float32/float16 are slower and heavier on CPU.)

variables.name: ASR_MODEL_PATH
variables.description: Where models are stored INSIDE the container. Must match the Models host-path mapping below.

variables.name: ASR_DEVICE
variables.description: cpu = run entirely on the processor + RAM. No GPU is requested.

variables.name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
variables.description: CPU threads used for transcription. Set near your core count for best speed.

variables.name: MODEL_IDLE_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds of inactivity before the model is unloaded from RAM (0 = keep loaded). Set e.g. 300 to free RAM between jobs at the cost of a reload delay.
